nuggets.text: The Herd's home, Joan C. Edwards Stadium, is one of only two Division I stadiums named exclusively for a woman.
The Thundering Herd's stadium has new LED lights this year, and they can turn the whole place green.
The Herd first met Middle Tennessee in the 1992 I-AA playoffs, winning 35-21 on the way to the national title.
The 1996 Thundering Herd went a perfect 15-0 and won the I-AA national championship.
Thundering Herd tight end Toby Payne caught a career-high eight passes in the season opener.
Hall of Fame receiver Randy Moss played his college football for the Thundering Herd.
Joan C. Edwards Stadium opened in 1991 with a 24-23 Thundering Herd win over New Hampshire.
The Herd leads the series with Middle Tennessee 7-5 and is 5-1 when the teams meet in Huntington.
Herd coach Tony Gibson was born in Van, West Virginia, and played defensive back at Glenville State.
The Thundering Herd will honor Marshall's 2026 Athletics Hall of Fame class, including Jon Elmore, during the first quarter.
